# ABSTRACT SECURITY
**The Security Data Pipeline Platform.** Send detection-ready data straight into Microsoft Sentinel — normalized, enriched, cost-optimized.

[abstract.security](https://abstract.security) · [Documentation](https://docs.abstractsecurity.app/docs/integrations/destination-integrations/azure-sentinel-destination/)

---
### Azure Sentinel — Destination Integration (ONE-CLICK, incl. app registration)
This **advanced** deployment provisions the **full ingestion stack** *and* **creates the Entra app registration for you** via an Azure deployment script — storing the client secret in **Key Vault** (never in a deployment output). It then grants the new service principal **both** `Monitoring Metrics Publisher` **and** `Monitoring Contributor` on the DCR.

⚠️ **Prerequisite:** you must supply a **user-assigned managed identity that already holds the *Application Administrator* directory role** (ARM cannot bootstrap that permission). The deploying user needs **Owner** (or **Contributor + User Access Administrator**) on the resource group.

💡 Prefer the *standard* Sentinel Destination template + `scripts/new-abstract-sentinel-app.*` if you'd rather keep the client secret out of Azure entirely.

When the deployment finishes, read the app/client id, tenant id and DCR/DCE/stream values from the **Outputs** tab, and retrieve the **client secret from Key Vault** to paste into Abstract.

elements.name: mode
elements.label: Log Analytics workspace
elements.toolTip: Create a fresh workspace (and enable Sentinel on it), or target an existing workspace in THIS resource group.

allowedValues.label: Use an existing workspace (in this resource group)

elements.name: workspaceNameNew
elements.label: New workspace name (leave empty to auto-generate)

constraints.validationMessage: 4-63 chars, letters/numbers/hyphens, or empty to auto-generate.

elements.name: workspaceNameExisting
elements.label: Existing workspace name
elements.toolTip: The exact name of an existing Log Analytics workspace in this resource group.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the exact existing workspace name (4-63 chars).

elements.name: existingWorkspaceLocation
elements.label: Existing workspace region
elements.toolTip: The Azure region of the existing workspace (e.g. eastus2). The DCE and DCR must be created in the SAME region as the workspace. Leave empty only if the workspace is in this deployment's region.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the workspace region short name (e.g. eastus, westeurope), or leave empty.

elements.name: workspaceRetentionDays
elements.label: Workspace retention (days)
elements.toolTip: Applied when creating a new workspace.

elements.name: enableSentinel
elements.label: Enable Microsoft Sentinel on the new workspace

options.text: Creates a Data Collection Endpoint, a custom *_CL table, and a Data Collection Rule that routes Abstract's stream into the table. The DCR stream name becomes 'Custom-<table name>' — that exact value is your 'Log Stream Name' in Abstract. The default table schema is minimal (TimeGenerated, Message, AbstractEvent); to capture explicit per-field ACS columns, deploy via CLI with a tableColumns parameter from Abstract's all_fields.json.

elements.name: customTableName
elements.label: Custom log table name
elements.toolTip: Must end in _CL. The Abstract 'Log Stream Name' will be Custom-<this value>.

constraints.validationMessage: Letters, numbers and underscores; must start with a letter and end with _CL (e.g. AbstractEventLogs_CL).
3-44 chars: letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, periods.
3-64 chars: letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, periods.

options.text: This template creates the Entra app registration for you using an Azure deployment script that runs AS the managed identity you supply below. That identity MUST already hold the 'Application Administrator' (or Cloud Application Administrator) directory role — ARM cannot grant it. The generated client secret is written to Key Vault, never to a deployment output.

elements.name: managedIdentityResourceId
elements.label: User-assigned managed identity resource ID
elements.toolTip: Full resource ID of a user-assigned managed identity that holds Application Administrator. Format: /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/<name>

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the full resource ID of a user-assigned managed identity.

elements.name: appDisplayName
elements.label: Entra app display name
elements.toolTip: Display name for the app registration created for Abstract. Reused if one with this name already exists.

elements.name: secretValidityYears
elements.label: Client secret validity
elements.toolTip: How long the generated client secret is valid.

elements.name: keyVaultName
elements.label: Key Vault name (leave empty to auto-generate)
elements.toolTip: Key Vault that will hold the generated client secret. Empty = auto-generate abstract-kv-<hash>. Must be globally unique.

constraints.validationMessage: 3-24 chars, lowercase letters/numbers/hyphens, start with a letter — or empty to auto-generate.

elements.name: secretReaderObjectId
elements.label: Secret reader object ID (optional)
elements.toolTip: Object ID of a user or group to grant 'Key Vault Secrets User' so they can read the generated secret to paste into Abstract. Leave empty to grant no reader.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a GUID (object id) or empty.
